author: Tabdelno
quote: After 20 hours of play, it would be difficult to overstate my disappointment in this game. Repetitive missions, glitches-a-plenty, and jittery, shoddy animations, all capped off by a “targetted” 30 fps rate that regularly dips below that. What were they doing for a decade?

author: Tabdelno
quote: This is very simple— Nintendo has taken the game that is almost universally regarded as the greatest of all time, and has improved it. Buy this game.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Tabdelno
quote: The best, most complete game in the Final Fantasy series, and I've played them all.

author: Tabdelno
quote:
The best Final Fantasy game since Final Fantasy X, and easily one of the top five Final Fantasy games of all time.

Proof that the series is alive and well.

author: Tabdelno
quote: SO many of the critiques miss the point— the overall game style is fantastic, the movement feels great, the "puzzles" are satisfying— it's just a great experience.

author: Tabdelno
quote:
The ultimate chill out game for fans of DQ. Cynical punks will find plenty to malign here— that’s your sign to roundly ignore them and enjoy this delightful JRPG. A must for fans of DQ XI, or an excellent entry point into that title— one of the best games of all time.

Charming story, fun gameplay, and a purple cat and green pig as companions— what more are you looking for. Square Enix has done it again.

Now give us a DQ XII teaser, Yuji Horii. That, or ports of DQ 4-9 for the Switch. Nobody wants to play games on their phones.

author: Tabdelno
quote: The best entry in an excellent series. If you’ve ever enjoyed a Shin Megami Tensei game before, this has all of those elements refined to the highest degree. If you’re a JRPG fan generally, but haven’t made the plunge into SMT before, this is the entry point. If you don’t like turn-based JRPGs, this isn’t the game for you.

author: Tabdelno
quote: If I were to be asked by somebody unfamiliar with the medium whether video games could be art, I’d say that they could, and would give this game as my proof. People giving this game anything other than excellent scores are, simply put, philistines. Nuff said.

author: Tabdelno
quote: The notion that anybody would actually assign a game (with properly functioning controls) a lower score simply because it is too difficult for them is, frankly, PATHETIC. Git gud, folks. Your lack of skill is not a deficiency in this genius game.

author: Tabdelno
quote: Turn based JRPGs are not only surviving; they’re thriving. This game is a great example. Loving it.

author: Tabdelno
quote: Don’t listen to the jokers who came into this with preconceived notions of what this game should be— the sheer creativity, humor, and fun play of this game can not be overstated.

author: Tabdelno
quote: One of the best JRPGs ever made, in its best version. What else is there to say, except people who were fretting about graphics are wrong— it looks great.

author: Tabdelno
quote: This game is saving the sanity of the human race. Brilliantly executed. Lol review bombers.

author: Tabdelno
quote: Great in-game shoutouts to the 1964 Games and fun gameplay. Clever stuff here. Implements the new sports nicely.
game_title: Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Games Tokyo 2020

author: Tabdelno
quote: A truly deep, charming, and original game with satisfying gameplay and unrivaled VIBE. The soundtrack and even typefaces are fantastic.

author: Tabdelno
quote: Easily the game of the year. The best strategy RPG ever made. Incredibly well conceived.

author: Tabdelno
quote:
Lappy laughs at review bombers. Buy a Switch, losers.

This game is incredibly deep, and the combat, story, and sensibility are incredible.
